reason: I'll connect the breathing drive to the apparatus; it's the only offered combination.

effect: The completed apparatus shows how diaphragm movement pulls the lungs outward through the pleural interface and how recoil helps air leave, resolving my main question about the connection.
reaction: The paired breathing views are a satisfying payoff, though the mechanics of the pleural interface remain fairly brief.

mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the breathing drive was most worthwhile: the planned paired views link diaphragm movement, airflow and lung recoil to the assembled circulation.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the diaphragm was relatively uneventful on its own: its placement was clear, but its movement was not shown until the next result.

surprise.text: The breathing drive introduced CO₂ feedback, adding a regulatory connection beyond simply sending signals to muscles. How CO₂ adjusts the rhythm was not explained.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless: the slots and compatible options made the connections clear. The pleural interface was named before its role was explained, however.

continue.text: I would continue to see how another body system connects to this one; the final airflow explanation made the assembled parts feel useful. That is a personal judgment, not evidence of student comprehension or enjoyment.
